final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and largely narrowed its position by conceding the core unresolved predicates. That reframing is useful but not evidentiary. On the available record, the limitation is material under the policy text, and the record still does not show any of the required pre-launch compliance paths: resolution, required disclosure, or approved risk acceptance. Public governance guidance and aggregate launch-readiness evidence support a narrower claim that the model may be broadly launch-ready in operational terms, but they do not establish policy compliance for certifying this named use case without the missing disclosure or approval link. Because some evidence supports general readiness while the decisive compliance predicate remains unresolved, suspicious remains the proportional classification rather than compliant_with_caveats or noncompliant.
